evidence.title: Runlayer, Rippling drop lawsuits — but the brouhaha is still a cautionary tale for founders

summary: Runlayer and Rippling have withdrawn their lawsuits against each other, but the dispute serves as a warning for AI founders about legal and competitive risks. The case underscores the importance of navigating intellectual property and market competition carefully in the fast-moving AI sector.
title: Runlayer and Rippling Drop Lawsuits, Highlighting Cautionary Tale for AI Startups
